entities.summary: Mikayil Huseyn oglu Abdullayev was a Soviet and Azerbaijani painter. He was awarded the honorary title of People's Painter of the USSR (1963) and People's Painter of the Azerbaijan SSR (1963). Abdullayev created a series of paintings entitled Through India.
